caption: The drawing depicts a single high-backed wooden chair with an enclosed design, featuring armrests and a slightly curved top edge. The chair is rendered in varying shades of brown, with darker tones used to indicate shadowed or recessed areas and lighter tones highlighting the external edges and surfaces exposed to light. The seat is rectangular, and the armrests are gently curved with decorative cutouts along the sides. The paneling on the back and sides of the chair is visibly segmented, with joints and wooden texture carefully illustrated. The chair is isolated against a plain, off-white or cream-colored background, with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The artist’s signature, "Ethelbert Brown," is inscribed in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Chair
